def select_next_node(current_node, destination_node, unvisited_nodes, distance_matrix, iteration=1):
    def node_score(node):
        proximity = distance_matrix[current_node][node]
        progress_towards_destination = distance_matrix[node][destination_node]
        isolation_penalty = sum(distance_matrix[node][prev_node] for prev_node in visited_nodes) if visited_nodes else 0
        weight_proximity = 1.0 / iteration
        weight_progress = 1.0
        weight_isolation = 0.5 / (iteration + 1)
        return (weight_proximity * proximity) + (weight_progress / (progress_towards_destination + 1)) + (weight_isolation / (isolation_penalty + 1))

    visited_nodes = previously_visited_nodes if 'previously_visited_nodes' in globals() else set()
    visited_nodes.add(current_node)
    next_node = min(unvisited_nodes, key=node_score)
    return next_node
